raw.details:
Competition Description:

DATATHON 2026 is a data science and AI/ML-focused competition presented by the School of Data Science, Symbiosis University of Applied Sciences, Indore, with Boston Institute of Analytics (BIA), Indore – Race Course Road as the Exclusive Knowledge Partner.

The event challenges participants to use Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning to solve real-world problems across multiple domains, including Healthcare, Smart Cities, Agriculture, Finance, E-Commerce, Education, Social Media, and Environment.

Event Details:

  • Date: 29 September 2026
  • Time: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM
  • Venue: Engineering Block, SUAS Indore
  • Eligibility: 12th / Undergraduate / Postgraduate students
  • Team Size: 3–5 members or solo participation
  • Registration Fee: ₹250
  • Prize Pool: ₹6,700
  • 1st Prize: ₹3,100
  • 2nd Prize: ₹2,100
  • 3rd Prize: ₹1,500
  • Participation Certificates: Provided to all participants
  • NO SHORTLISTING ROUND

Competition Format:

Participants will work on real-world problem statements and develop data-driven solutions using AI/ML and related technologies.

The competition focuses on:

  • Data analysis and interpretation
  • Machine Learning / AI model development
  • Problem-solving
  • Real-world application of data science
  • Building practical and innovative solutions

Participants can participate individually or in teams of 3–5 members.

Problem Domains:

Problem statements are based on real-world challenges from domains such as:

  • Healthcare
  • Smart Cities
  • Agriculture
  • Finance
  • E-Commerce
  • Education
  • Social Media
  • Environment

Eligibility & Team Rules:

  • Open to students studying in 12th standard, Undergraduate, or Postgraduate programs.
  • Participants may compete solo or in teams of 3–5 members.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Participants should follow the official instructions provided by the organizers during the event.

Duration:

The overall event is scheduled from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM on 29 September 2026.

Rules:

  • Participants must meet the specified eligibility criteria.
  • Participation is allowed either individually or in teams of 3–5 members.
  • Participants are expected to solve the assigned real-world problem using appropriate Data Science, AI, and/or ML approaches.
  • Solutions should address the given problem statement and demonstrate practical application.
  • Participants must follow the instructions and submission requirements provided by the organizers.
  • Evaluation and final selection will be conducted according to the competition guidelines provided by the organizers.
  • Participants should maintain originality in their submitted solutions.
  • Any additional rules, judging criteria, submission format, or round-specific instructions will be communicated by the event organizers.

Prizes & Recognition:

Participants get the opportunity to compete for cash prizes:

  • ₹3,100 — First Prize
  • ₹2,100 — Second Prize
  • ₹1,500 — Third Prize

Participation certificates will be provided to all participants.

Why Participate:

DATATHON 2026 provides students with an opportunity to work on real-world data science and AI/ML problems, apply technical knowledge in practical scenarios, develop innovative solutions, and compete with other students. The event also provides exposure to problem-solving across multiple industries and domains.
